title: Google Calendar
description: Creates an event in, or lists upcoming events of, a Google Calendar.

connectionId.title: Connection
connectionId.description: Google Calendar connection used to read or create events.

calendarId.title: Calendar ID
calendarId.description: Calendar to add the event to. Defaults to the primary calendar.

start.title: Start
start.description: Start as an RFC 3339 date-time (2026-10-05T09:00:00+07:00) or an all-day date (2026-10-05). A date-time without an offset needs a time zone.

end.title: End
end.description: End in the same format as the start; it must be after the start. For all-day events the end date is exclusive.

timeZone.title: Time zone
timeZone.description: IANA time zone name (for example Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). Needed when the start has no UTC offset.

sendInvitations.title: Send invitations
sendInvitations.description: Email invitations to the attendees. Off by default: attendees are added to the event without an email.

operation.title: Operation
operation.description: create (default) adds an event; list returns upcoming events.

timeMin.title: From
timeMin.description: list: start of the window as an RFC 3339 date-time with offset (2026-10-05T09:00:00+07:00) or a date. Defaults to now. A date without a time means midnight UTC; an offset date-time is recommended.

timeMax.title: Until
timeMax.description: list: end of the window, same format as From; it must be after From. Optional. A date without a time means midnight UTC; an offset date-time is recommended.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: list: maximum events returned, 1 to 50, default 10.

query.title: Search text
query.description: list: only events matching this text (title, description, location).
